title: How do I reschedule a job?
body:
Reschedule a job

🖥️ServiceTitan screen walkthrough — captured from the live the company tenant.
  • Open the job from the dispatch board or Calls.
  • Tap Reschedule, pick the new arrival window.
  • Confirm the customer and trigger the ETA/confirmation message.
  • Check the new slot doesn't create a conflict for that tech.
Tip: always send the customer the updated confirmation — silent reschedules cause 'where's my plumber?' calls.

title: Where's the GP on a quote?
body:
Finding gross profit on a quote

🖥️ServiceTitan screen walkthrough — captured from the live the company tenant.

Pricebook lines already hold 50% GP. On the estimate screen, the margin column shows per-line and total GP. If a quote drops below 50%, a discount has been applied — review before it goes out.

title: Creating a customer without duplicates
body:
Avoid duplicate records

🖥️ServiceTitan screen walkthrough — captured from the live the company tenant.
  • Search by phone first, then address.
  • Only create new if there's truly no match.
  • If you spot a duplicate, merge — never create a third.

title: Recording materials correctly
body:
Materials = margin

🖥️ServiceTitan screen walkthrough — captured from the live the company tenant.

Add every material from the pricebook as you use it. Unrecorded materials are gross profit lost. Don't freehand prices — the pricebook handles that.

title: Presenting Good-Better-Best
body:
The three-option presentation

Always present three tiers. 'Good' solves it; 'Better' adds protection/service; 'Best' is the premium, longest-lasting solution. Let the customer choose up — never present a single price.

Attach: include the membership plan in the Better and Best tiers.

title: Reading the pace rate
body:
Pace rate explained

🖥️ServiceTitan screen walkthrough — captured from the live the company tenant.

Pace rate projects where the month lands if today's run-rate holds. Below target means you need a higher daily average for the remaining working days. Monthly budget is the source of truth; daily/weekly targets derive from it.

title: Handling a price objection
body:
Hold value, don't discount

A price objection is usually unclear value. Reframe: licensed, insured, on-time, guaranteed, and the cost of getting it wrong. Get a tech on site for an accurate price rather than quoting blind.

title: The five job stages
body:
New → Scheduled → Completed → Invoiced → Paid

Every job lives in one stage. Watch for jobs stuck in Completed (unbilled) or Invoiced (unpaid). Reconcile daily.

title: Classifying job type on a call
body:
Service, install or emergency?

Classification drives urgency, window and tech selection. Emergency = same-day priority. Listen for trigger words: 'flooding', 'no hot water', 'burst', 'sewage'.

title: The 50/20/200 guardrails
body:
The three numbers

50% gross profit, 20% net profit, $200K per truck per month. Every operational decision is checked against these. If a choice breaks the line, it needs a strong reason.

title: Before & after photos
body:
Photo discipline

🖥️ServiceTitan screen walkthrough — captured from the live the company tenant.

Before-photos show the customer the problem and protect you. After-photos prove the work and make the invoice and review easy. Take both on every job.

title: Following up a stale quote
body:
The follow-up cadence

Most lost revenue dies in the silence after a quote. Work the cadence (12-month / 15-touch logic) before marking anything lost. A tracked follow-up recovers jobs others let go.
